title: Home energy audit sheet
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y6 lesson 14 (Home energy audit sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 14: Climate change: causes and effects. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Explain how a car journey adds to climate change

parts.text: More carbon dioxide traps more heat

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Burning fossil fuels adds greenhouse gases, which trap heat

keywords.def: a long-term change in Earth's climate
a gas that traps heat, like carbon dioxide
coal, oil and gas, made from ancient plants and animals
the height of the sea's surface

questions.q: Why does cutting down forests add to climate change?
questions.a: Trees take in carbon dioxide; fewer trees means more stays in the air (and burning them releases more)

questions.q: Give one effect of rising sea levels.
questions.a: Flooding of coasts and low islands

questions.q: Core: Make a cause and effect chain for climate change with three causes and three effects, linked by arrows.
Extend: In the portal response box, explain one effect on a named place (for example the Maldives or the Arctic).
questions.a: For example: the Maldives is very low, so rising seas threaten islands

questions.q: Stretch: Why is the natural greenhouse effect good, but too much bad?
questions.a: Some keeps Earth warm enough; too much traps extra heat and changes climates
B) Coal. Coal formed from ancient plants; wind and sunlight are renewable.

questions.q: Big question: why does one or two degrees matter?
questions.a: Small global changes melt ice, raise seas and bring more extreme weather that affects people and wildlife
